name: Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 2
overview: Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 2 is the second volume of the Looney Tunes Platinum Collection. It is a Blu-ray and DVD box set by Warner Home Video containing fifty Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies cartoons, ten of which are newly remastered shorts that have never been released on the Looney Tunes Golden Collection, among numerous supplements. Both versions were released 16 October 2012.
